prompt:
A previous code import left the invoice and reporting logic collapsed into a few catch-all files under src/ (for example src/m1.js, src/m2.js, src/m3.js, src/m4.js, and src/lib/z.js), each mixing several unrelated concerns. This makes the billing code painful to change safely.

Reorganize the invoice and reporting code into clear, single-responsibility modules at these canonical paths: src/invoices/filters.js (status and due-date filtering), src/invoices/export.js (CSV export), src/invoices/totals.js (per-invoice totals), src/invoices/summary.js (by-status summary), and src/shared/money.js (shared money helpers). Keep src/index.js as the public entrypoint that re-exports the same API. The observable behavior and the public API must not change.
issue_title: Invoice reporting code is hard to maintain after a legacy import
issue_body:
A previous code import left the invoice and reporting logic collapsed into a few catch-all files under src/ (for example src/m1.js, src/m2.js, src/m3.js, src/m4.js, and src/lib/z.js), each mixing several unrelated concerns. This makes the billing code painful to change safely.

Reorganize the invoice and reporting code into clear, single-responsibility modules at these canonical paths: src/invoices/filters.js (status and due-date filtering), src/invoices/export.js (CSV export), src/invoices/totals.js (per-invoice totals), src/invoices/summary.js (by-status summary), and src/shared/money.js (shared money helpers). Keep src/index.js as the public entrypoint that re-exports the same API. The observable behavior and the public API must not change.
expected_behavior: The public reporting and billing behavior is unchanged: filtering, CSV export, per-invoice totals, and the by-status summary all produce the same results as before.
The public entrypoint src/index.js keeps exporting the same functions, so existing callers do not change how they import.
Each concern lives in its own focused module and the catch-all files are gone.
expected_failure_summary: Invoice/reporting concerns are collapsed into opaque catch-all files; the canonical per-concern modules do not exist so behaviour cannot be imported at its expected location.
task_author_notes: Broken collapses invoices/{filters,export,summary,totals,schema} + shared/money into m1/m2/m3/lib/z. Restoring the per-concern modules under src/invoices and src/shared with preserved behaviour, re-exported via index.js, satisfies both the hidden behaviour tests and the structure contract.
